title: Martha Cooks
description:
S2 E9 — Martha and the Chocolate Factory
Martha visits Mast Market in Mt. Kisco, N.Y., and learns the art behind making their renowned chocolate; from roasting cacao, to stone grinding, to forming delicious bars and chips.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E2 — India: A Tour of Food
Martha's friend and restaurateur, Shiva Natarajan, shares the key to making any Indian dish - spices; back in Martha's kitchen, they make butter chicken, lemon rice, and a tangy yogurt sauce.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E3 — Magic Mushrooms
Martha learns about the magic of mushrooms; mushroom expert Andrew Carter explains each mushroom variety; Martha and mushroom cookbook author Andrea Gentl make delicious mushroom recipes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S4 E13 — Lamb
Butterflied, rolled and roasted leg of lamb; lamb tagine with spiced butternut squash and prunes; yogurt-marinated lamb kebabs; seared loin lamb chops served with mint jelly and fried fingerling potatoes.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E3 — Vegetables
Simple vegetable side dishes include steamed spinach, sautéed broccoli rabe, roasted cauliflower steaks, brown sugar-glazed carrots, sautéed sugar snap peas and shelled peas with mint and lemony kale salad.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E6 — Rice
Fluffy white rice; pilaf; risotto; Thai fried rice.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E7 — Dressings and Emulsions
Shallot vinaigrette prepared two different ways; creamy blue cheese dressing; mayonnaise; BLT.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E8 — Steaming
Cooking chicken breasts in parchment paper; cleaning and steaming mussels; using a bamboo steamer to prepare steamed salmon and peas.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E10 — Braising
Which cuts of meat are good for braising; classic pot roast; braised cabbage with apples; pulled pork sandwiches.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S1 E12 — Frying
French fries; pan-fried chicken; Japanese tempura vegetables with dipping sauces.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E4 — Cookies
Brown sugar chocolate chip cookies; old-fashioned lemon sugar cookies; chewy chocolate ginger-molasses cookies; sable; glazed citrus doodles.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E5 — Custards
Crème caramel; crème brûlée; cherry clafoutis; mocha custards.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E6 — Croissants
Light, crispy croissants; pain au chocolat; ham and cheese minicroissants; pain aux raisins.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E7 — Special Breads
Irish soda bread; olive and cheese loaf; Sally Lunn; custard-filled cornbread.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E9 — Basic Breads
White, multigrain and rye breads; Parker House rolls.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E10 — Focaccia and Pizza
Oven-dried heirloom tomato pizza; grape focaccia; thin tarte flambée; three-cheese gluten-free calzone.

title: Martha Bakes
description:
S2 E9 — Basic Breads
White, multigrain and rye breads; Parker House rolls.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E2 — Growing Citrus
Martha explores the incredible world of citrus from yuzus and kumquats to citrons and mandarins; Martha visits Flavors by Bhumi in her home state of New Jersey to learn all about growing citrus.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E3 — Getting the Garden Going
Martha prepares her garden for the season's splendor - from planting hellebores to propagating trees to proper lawn care; plus, succulent pots for early color.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E4 — Tropical Plants That Can Grow Anywhere
Martha travels to Florida for all things tropical plants; Martha explores inspiring gardens and landscapes in Palm Beach, highlighting diverse varieties of tropical plants that can be grown anywhere.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E5 — Container Gardening Made Easy
Martha shares the dos and don'ts of container gardening from choosing what to plant and the right container to sharing her key tips for nutrient-rich soil; a glossary of underplantings to give potted plants a finished look.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E4 — Picture Perfect Rolled Lasagna
Restaurant owners Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli join Martha in making their rolled lasagna with San Marzano tomato sauce, Italian bolognese, and chrysanthemum Caesar salad.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E5 — Easy Homemade Dumplings
Martha, Monica Tran Carden, and Andrew Yu make homemade dumplings; Martha and Monica hand-make wontons and pork dumplings; Andrew and Martha prepare jade dumplings and pork and shrimp dumplings.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E6 — The Bagel Show
Martha samples bagel toppings and is joined by Gary Greengrass, owner of Barney Greengrass, an NYC staple; at PopUp Bagels, Martha makes bagels and constructs breakfast sandwiches with Adam Goldberg.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S3 E7 — Martha's Favorite Cakes
Martha makes the classic meringue cake from Casa Cipriani with pastry chef Alessia Tomassetti; Martha and bakery owner Lucie Franc De Ferriere bake a pear raspberry cake with jam and maple buttercream.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E1 — Martha Hosts a Derby Party
Kevin Sharkey makes mint juleps and deviled eggs; a Churchill Downs Racetrack centerpiece; chef Pierre Schaedelin walks Martha through food preparation for the party; Martha gets fitted by hat milliner Jackie Ciconga for the perfect Derby ensemble.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E2 — The Art of Raw Food
Martha and Omar Abou-Ismail make miso soup and a bean-free hummus with flatbread made with raw ingredients; Martha and Omar whip up a tabouli salad followed by sweet potato fries.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S4 E3 — Baking Baguettes and Breads
Martha tours Breads Bakery with owner Gadi Paleg and learns about their award-winning baked goods; Martha and bakers make Breads Bakery's baguette, challah, and egg sandwich.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E1 — Preserves; Tool Handles; Composting
Jams and jellies; fruits; composting; painting garden tools.
